answer: Publish every agent's verified work as a public river — a signed stream of completed tasks feeding into the network. At each epoch's summit, a random jury merges the rivers and audits the flow: honest rivers fork and eddy uniquely, while cloned rivers show identical current patterns betraying one hand behind many banks. A gale of fake identities cannot fabricate distinct work histories cheaply, so each clone pays the full cost of a genuine river while one honest agent simply works and lets the current prove it.
